stories.title: Update: Jamia students call off protest and hunger strike after registrar's order sets May 2027 deadline for union constitution
stories.body:
Jamia Millia Islamia students called off their protest and hunger strike, which began on Monday 12 October, after Registrar Mahtab Alam Rizvi issued an order dated Thursday 29 October, ANI and The Wire reported late that night. The order sets Saturday 15 May 2027 as the deadline to complete approval and implementation of the students' union constitution, with elections within six weeks of the academic session starting around 16 July 2027, following Lyngdoh Committee guidelines. It revokes show-cause notices, suspensions, rustication and campus bans linked to the protest. The Wire reports offline classes and exams resume on Monday 2 November.

The Wire adds that two FIRs filed by Delhi Police over alleged vandalism leave some students' position unclear. The students' demand for the Chief Proctor's removal was not addressed in the order, ANI reports.
stories.check: NEEDS CHECK: The Wire says offline classes resume on Monday 2 November; Outlook India (27 Oct) reported online classes until Sunday 8 November. Confirm the date with Jamia. The order was not seen directly (no press release found after 6177 on 27 Oct; the release site blocks automated access). Status of the two FIRs and of any students in custody (The Wire reports two student activists were sent to judicial custody) is single-source; confirm with Delhi Police and Jamia. Earlier reports differed on whether the strike had ended; ANI and The Wire now both say it was called off.

CV Raman Marg Daily Brief, Fri 30 Oct

Jamia: students called off their protest and hunger strike (on since 12 Oct) after the registrar's order of Thu 29 Oct (ANI, The Wire). Union constitution to be approved by 15 May 2027; polls within six weeks of the session starting around 16 July 2027. Suspensions and campus bans linked to the protest are revoked.

The Wire says offline classes resume Mon 2 Nov; an earlier report said online until 8 Nov. Confirm.

No confirmed BSES, DJB, MCD, Delhi Police or Delhi Traffic Police items for our localities.
